intro: Lesson 62: Wave basics: types of wave and v = fλ. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: (a) Draw a transverse wave and label amplitude and wavelength [2]. (b) A water wave has speed 1.5 m/s and frequency 0.5 Hz. Find its wavelength [2]. (c) State what is transferred by the wave [1] and one difference from a longitudinal wave [1].
questions.a: (a) correct labels (2); (b) λ = v ÷ f = 1.5 ÷ 0.5 = 3 m (2); (c) energy (1); vibrations perpendicular rather than parallel to energy transfer (1)
questions.model: Teacher draws the wave on screen and labels the amplitude from the rest line to a crest.

questions.q: Radio waves travel at 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s. Find the wavelength of a 100 MHz station.
Why does a cork bobbing on water not move towards the shore with the wave?
questions.a: Water particles oscillate about a fixed position; only energy moves.

questions.q: Sound of frequency 256 Hz has wavelength 1.3 m. Speed?
questions.model: Write v = fλ. Substitute 256 and 1.3. 256 × 1.3 = 332.8, so about 333 m/s.
